datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Mozambique in 2011, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases under different scenarios. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions aggregated at the administrative unit level.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity levels across geographic areas.
